scope: Independent local raw review of009+021 EP4/A2A/live and010+022 EP4/A2A/32768 only, including their14 pooled groups. Reuses accepted source/environment/full-gate; no validator/summarizer invoked as proof.
pooling_method: For each exact EP4/A2A/capacity/N/variant, concatenate repeat1 100 raw rank-MAX CUPTI samples and repeat2 100 raw samples, then median(all200)*1000 to microseconds. No trimming, no median-of-medians, no mixing capacity/N/communication.

derived_metric_definitions.signed_change_percent: 100 * (Mega_us / Split_us - 1); negative means lower Mega latency

limitations: This verifies14of110 paired groups in a22of60-job partial snapshot; it does not certify the full matrix or final performance conclusions.
Both repeats retain native cross-path FAIL at every N. Per-path/reference PASS is not cross-backend equivalence.
Reference errors and all-rank rank-MAX behavior are source-bound logged evidence; no input tensors, per-rank timestamp arrays or CUPTI activity buffers are replayed locally.
112 additional untimed graph replays pass; every timed replay is not separately numerically checked.
Pool medians use all200 values per arm unchanged; sample variability/outliers remain represented and two repeats are not a statistical confidence analysis.
Seven of14 groups reverse the sign of Mega latency change between repeats; pooled sign is a descriptive summary, not evidence of stable/statistically significant advantage or serving causality.

repeat_variability.interpretation: Observed sign reversals in7of14 paired groups. Pooled signs alone do not establish a stable or statistically significant advantage; no serving causality is inferred.
